title: GraphVQ: Structure-Aware Autoregressive Decoding over Context-Quantized Graph Tokens
abstract: arXiv:2609.37604v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Graph foundation models need a discrete token representation, but casting a graph as a generatable token sequence faces a structural obstacle: edges spanning beyond the serialization window cannot be emitted in one pass--so one-pass autoregressive generators systematically under-produce cycles--and a single global condition cannot tell candidate edges apart. GraphVQ removes both obstacles: node contexts--features plus a local edge mask under multi-order breadth-first serialization--are quantized into a shared codebook by a VQ-VAE with BCE-calibrated Bernoulli edge decoding, and a second-stage structure-aware decoder emits the global adjacency conditioned on token-derived pair features, whose necessity over any global-summary condition is formalized in a scoped impossibility result. The tokenizer reconstructs node features at 0.86--0.99 accuracy and decodes local edges at AUROC >= 0.89 (ECE <= 0.007). Under one same-split protocol on four

translated_title: GraphVQ：基于上下文量化图Token的结构感知自回归解码
translated_abstract: 图基础模型需要离散的token表示，但将图转化为可生成的token序列时面临一个结构性障碍：超出序列化窗口的边无法在一次生成中输出——因此单遍自回归生成器会系统性地少生成环——而且单一的全局条件无法区分候选边。GraphVQ消除了这两个障碍：节点上下文——即在多阶广度优先序列化下的节点特征加上局部边掩码——通过一个采用BCE校准的伯努利边解码的VQ-VAE被量化到共享码本中；随后，第二阶段的结构感知解码器以由token导出的成对特征为条件生成全局邻接结构，并通过一个限定范围的不可能性结果形式化证明了其相对于任何全局摘要条件的必要性。该分词器以0.86–0.99的准确率重构节点特征，并以AUROC ≥ 0.89（ECE ≤ 0.007）解码局部边。在一个统一的数据划分协议下，在四个……（摘要内容在此处截断）
tldr: GraphVQ通过VQ-VAE将多阶广度优先序列化下的节点上下文量化为共享码本token，并用基于token成对特征的结构感知第二阶段解码器生成全局邻接，从而解决了单遍自回归图生成中跨窗口边无法输出、全局条件无法区分候选边这两大障碍。
en_tdlr: GraphVQ overcomes the two structural obstacles of one-pass autoregressive graph generation—inability to emit edges beyond the serialization window and the failure of a single global condition to distinguish candidate edges—by quantizing node contexts into a shared codebook via a VQ-VAE and using a structure-aware second-stage decoder conditioned on token-derived pair features.
